vms.name: Name
vms.forceStopDescription: The VM is turned off without shutting down its OS. Unsaved data in the guest is lost.
vms.deleteDescription: The VM is deleted. Its volumes are kept.

forms.name: Use 1–63 lowercase letters, digits and -, not starting or ending with -.

volumes.name: Name
volumes.createDescription: A new disk image in a storage pool. A qcow2 volume takes space only as it is written.
volumes.deleteDescription: The disk image and all data on it are deleted.

errors.exists: A volume with this name already exists.

pools.name: Name
pools.createDescription: A directory on the nodes that holds volume files. Create the directory on each node first.
pools.pathHint: An absolute path on the nodes.
pools.nodesHint: Leave all unchecked to use it on every node.
pools.deleteDescription: Only the pool is removed. Files in its directory stay on the nodes.

networks.name: Name
networks.userNote: The user network (QEMU NAT) is always available and is not listed.
networks.createDescription: Points VM interfaces at a Linux bridge that already exists on the nodes. VMs on this network run only on nodes with the bridge.
networks.deleteDescription: Only the network is removed. The bridges on the nodes are not changed.

errors.reserved: The name user is reserved for NAT.

nodes.name: Name
nodes.joinNote: To add a node, issue a join token on the Cluster page and run oplctl cluster join on the new node.
nodes.maintenanceNote: No new VMs are placed on a node in maintenance. VMs already running there keep running.
nodes.removeDescription: Only for a node that is dead for good. It cannot rejoin with its current data, and VMs assigned to it stay assigned.

vmForm.runningNote: The VM is running: its node and disks cannot change. Other changes apply from the next start.

errors.name: Use 1–63 lowercase letters, digits and -, not starting or ending with -.
errors.bootOrder: Boot orders must be unique numbers from 1 to 255.
errors.volumeDuplicate: Each disk needs a different volume.
errors.volumeExists: A volume with this name already exists.
errors.macMulticast: A multicast address (odd first byte) cannot be used.
errors.macDuplicate: Each interface needs a different MAC address.

console.failed: Disconnected. The VM may have stopped or the console is not available.
console.pasteDenied: The browser did not allow reading the clipboard.
console.pasteTruncated: Only the first {{count}} characters were typed.
console.hint: Click the screen to type into the VM. Click outside it to release the keyboard.
console.forbidden: You do not have permission to use the console.
